description: This Java source file implements the ProductRelationshipDao interface, providing methods to retrieve product relationship data from a database using JPA/Hibernate. It includes queries for fetching product relationships based on type, group, products, and store, employing complex HQL statements with multiple fetch joins.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductRelationshipDao for accessing product relationship data via JPA/Hibernate.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships filtered by type, store, product, and language.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Fetches product relationships associated with a specific group code.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns product relationships that are groupings without associated products, identified by null product fields.

methods.name: listByProducts
methods.description: Lists all relationships involving a specific product, either as main or related product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Fetches relationships by type and product, considering store context.
